title: Geometric regularity transport across a chosen fraction field
statement: For a Noetherian domain A, a chosen fraction field K, and an A-algebra C, if the tensor fibre of C over the canonical generic residue field is geometrically regular, then the base change TensorProduct A K C is geometrically regular over K.

proof.text: Use the universal property of fraction fields to construct the unique A-algebra equivalence between K and the canonical fraction field. Transport finite purely inseparable extensions and regularity through this equivalence, and use the canonical tensor-product associativity and equivalence to identify the two base changes.
